finding.title: Per-row Python loop in _comfort_terms_batch costs 13-32% of every solve; a row-vectorized twin is bit-identical here
finding.claim: HeatPumpOptimizer._comfort_terms_batch spends 0.134-0.321 of optimize() thread CPU (0.32 on every two-zone cell) in a per-row numpy loop, and a twin that does the same elementwise ops on the [B, n] batch and reduces with axis=1 returns bitwise-identical penalty and comfort arrays and the same plans on all 8 cells tested, at 0.012-0.039 of the solve.

The docstring keeps the loop for cross-backend bit parity; the measured twin gives 0 bit mismatches on x86_64, which is where the docstring says a batched reduction re-planned 19 of 51 stress scenarios.

finding.title: L-BFGS-B asks the scalar objective for f(x) every iterate at ~19-26x a batched row: 9-19% of the solve
finding.claim: _multi_start_minimize hands scipy a scalar fun and a batched jac separately, so every iterate evaluates the scalar objective (1.0-1.6 ms, 18.6-25.9x one batched row) before the 96-row gradient batch; that scalar path is 0.087-0.192 of optimize() thread CPU, and serving f from an extra row 0 of the same batch (jac=True) drops it to 0.005-0.018 with every plan bitwise unchanged.
finding.mechanism: scipy's ScalarFunction calls fun(x) then jac(x); the memo (#288) only saves the jac's f0 re-evaluation, not the scalar evaluation itself, which runs simulate_trajectory as a Python loop of simulate_step with a dataclasses.replace per step. The batched kernel's cost is per-call overhead amortised over rows, so a 97th row costs ~0.04-0.08 ms where the scalar call costs 1.0-1.6 ms. A one-row batch per scalar call is dearer still (recorded negative arm --via-batch: share 0.15 -> 0.31).

finding.claim: _apply_dhw_min_run makes 7,758 of the solve's 11,064 simulate_dhw_step calls on the single-zone DHW winter cell (0.17-0.23 of optimize() CPU on four single-zone cells), 81 % of its weak slots are refused, and stopping each refused slot's check at its first breaching chunk cuts the calls 26-40 % (7,758 -> 4,780) with every plan bitwise unchanged; at 48 h the calls grow 3.26x for 2x the horizon.
